What we clean

Pressure washing and soft washing.

The right pressure for every surface: soft washing for siding and roofs, full pressure and surface cleaners for concrete.

House washing & soft washing

Low-pressure soft washing takes mildew, algae and dirt off siding, brick, stucco, trim and porches.

Learn more

Roof cleaning

Tile and shingle roofs soft washed to lift the dark streaks and stains, with low pressure instead of blasting.

Learn more

Driveways & concrete

FAQ

Questions before you call.

How do I get a price?

Call (361) 777-9140 or send the quote form. Quotes are free, and Moises can quote on site or over the phone, whichever is easier for you. There are no prices on this site because every property is different.

What does soft washing mean?

Soft washing cleans with low pressure and a cleaning solution rather than high pressure. It's the gentler way to wash siding, painted surfaces, stucco and roofs, which a pressure wand can damage.

When can you work?

Faz Power Washing is open 24 hours Monday to Saturday and closed Sunday, so businesses can book early mornings, evenings or overnight around their own hours.

Are you insured?

Yes. Faz Power Washing is insured.

Can I set up a regular schedule?

Yes. Recurring work is welcome, for homes and for businesses. Some customers book a cleaning every year, and the Texas State Aquarium has Faz back on a yearly schedule.

Do you travel outside the Coastal Bend?

For commercial and fleet work, yes: Faz Power Washing takes commercial jobs anywhere in Texas. Call to talk through the job and the location.

Do you clean inside windows?

No. Window cleaning at Faz Power Washing is the outside of the glass and frames only.
